skills: Up to 3 Ice hits; the 3rd heals 10% HP.

Hold to charge up to 3 levels, spending HP (faster at high HP, never below 25%); release for a charged hammer slam for massive Ice DMG. At level 2, press after for a 3rd Crushing Strike hit with up to +30% DMG. At level 3, higher Anti-Interrupt, and press to finish early.

Getting hit while charging or spinning blocks with tentacles (25% less DMG). Below full charge she counters for Ice DMG and gains a charge level. Press Basic for the finishing slam, or Special for a guaranteed Surging Cold.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.

Launching Ice strike. Clashing with an enemy attack triggers Surging Cold; hitting a Stunned enemy with enough Adrenaline triggers Crushing Pursuit. Either maxes her charge level; press Basic for the finishing slam.
Two rising strikes and an icy mist for massive Ice DMG; heals 33% of missing HP if it hit.
Dash, leap and a heavy smash for massive Ice DMG; heals 33% of missing HP if it hit. After Surging Cold it gives 15 Adrenaline (once per 1s). Press Basic after for the finishing slam.
Powerful strike for massive Ice DMG; tentacles join in inside Wellspring.

At max Decibels, the final hit of Frostbite Embrace, either EX or her Chain spends 3,000 Decibels to open Wellspring: squad Max HP +5% for 30s (extendable to 300s). Inside it she charges faster but burns HP faster.
Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
Within 30s of each Decibel-paid Wellspring: one wide strike for massive Ice DMG.

core.name: Dreamscape Collection
core.text:
Gains 0.1 Sheer Force per point of Max HP; all her Ice DMG is Sheer DMG, ignoring DEF. Enters battle with 60 Adrenaline (once per 180s in Investigation Zones).
The lower her HP, the more DMG she deals: up to +{0}% below 50% HP, kept for 5s after healing back to 50%. She gets fewer Decibels from hits but gains 10 per 1% HP lost.

ability.name: Narrative Completion
ability.text: Below 50% HP: +30% CRIT DMG and 25% less DMG taken. Inside Wellspring, a level-3 Frostbite Embrace or Glacial Crush summons an icy tentacle for extra DMG (counts as EX Special, scales with its level; once per 12s).

mindscapes: EX costs 10 less Adrenaline. Keep holding after an EX to spend 35 Adrenaline on another Glacial Crush, skipping the first heal; that Crush heals twice as much. Basics and EXs ignore 20% Ice RES.
+40% CRIT DMG. Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit give 0.5 Adrenaline per second for 30s.
10% more Decibels from losing HP. Inside Wellspring, +5% more Max HP.
Opening or extending Wellspring with Decibels gives Erudition for 30s: +25% Sheer DMG, and the first fatal hit leaves her at 1 HP, unkillable for 5s while healing 25% HP.
